The '''Colette''' was a model of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] produced by [[Vectron]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Vectron Colette was added to the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] with patch 5.1.2 and is available from the Vigilant Defender Pack.
